description: The line plot illustrates the comparison of Macro-F1 scores between two methods of materials tokenization: one incorporating domain knowledge (labeled as "MATTER (ours)") and the other without domain knowledge (labeled as "w/o material information"). The x-axis represents the number of tokens, ranging from 0.6 to 1.4, with a tick label interval of 0.2. The y-axis measures the Macro-F1 score, ranging from 48 to 58, with a tick label interval of 2. The line representing "MATTER (ours)" is marked with pink circles and a solid line, while the line for "w/o material information" is marked with purple circles and a dashed line. The "MATTER (ours)" line shows a generally higher Macro-F1 score across the number of tokens, with some fluctuations, and peaks around 0.8 and 1.0. The "w/o material information" line shows a more consistent score, with less variation, and a slight dip at 1.4. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions about the cause of the changes observed.
